subject: general
question: A rectangular plot is 420 m long and 84 m wide. It is surrounded by semi-circular flower beds along all its sides. The area of the entire plot (in hectares) is x. The value of x (correct to one decimal place) is (take ={{22} over 7}):
solution:
**Given:**

A rectangular plot is 420 m long and 84 m wide

**Concept used:**

Area of rectangle = l × b

Area of a circle = πr²

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c45d9217655f56a0927e3396ba704f6bb199a9b007fb40fc4ae9da0e39d3563b.png] 

According to the diagram,

There are 1 rectangle and 2 circles are present

So,

Area of the rectangle = 420 × 84 

⇒ 35280

Area of the 1st circle = 22/7 × 210 × 210 = 138600

Area of the 2nd circle = 22/7 × 42 × 42 = 5544

Total area = 35280 + 138600 + 5544 = 179424 m² ≈ 17.9

**∴ Required area is 17.9**
